providerLifecycleControlHelp.message: Check the protection status above. Updated routing data alone does not confirm that routing is active.

providerLifecycleHelp.message: Check for updates → Verify data → Prepare → Apply update.

providerLifecycleUnknownHelp.message: No update result is available yet.

providerLifecycleVerifiedHelp.message: The routing data passed the available integrity checks. This does not test proxy connections.

providerLifecyclePreparedHelp.message: The data passed verification and the update is ready to apply. Saved settings have not been applied.

providerLifecycleAppliedHelp.message: The current routing data is active. Availability of connections depends on the configured proxy services.

providerLifecycleAppliedOffHelp.message: The routing data was updated. Protection remains off.

providerLifecyclePreparationFailed.message: The update could not be prepared or applied. Check the protection status.

providerLifecycleBusyHelp.message: The update operation is in progress. Existing routing continues during preparation; saved settings stay pending.

transferUnsupported_authentication.message: Firefox has no global proxy-authentication switch. Review imported profiles before Apply; missing credentials still require re-entry.

transferHelp.message: Manual transfer of saved settings, not synchronization. Files contain site rules and proxy addresses, but no usernames or passwords. Export ignores unsaved edits. Import saves settings without applying or turning protection on.

transferImport.message: Import settings: choose a JSON file

transferSupportHelp.message: Support files contain only environment and status information, without site rules or proxy addresses. They cannot be imported as settings.

transferCounts.message: Rules: $1 (added/removed entries: $2). Proxy profiles: $3. Credentials to re-enter: $4.

transferReplaceWarning.message: This replaces saved routing settings. Missing credentials must be entered before Apply. Review the unsupported fields below; they are not transferred.

transferImported.message: Settings imported. They are saved but not applied.

transferExported.message: Export prepared. Keep settings files private.

transferInvalid.message: The file is not a valid settings export. Nothing was imported.

transferVersion.message: This export format version is not supported.

transferLimit.message: The import exceeds the size or complexity limit (maximum file size: 1 MiB).

transferDraft.message: Review and save or discard your edits before importing. Your edits have been preserved.

transferNoConfiguration.message: This is a support file, not a settings export.

transferConflict.message: Settings changed elsewhere. Choose the file again to review a fresh preview.

transferCredentialsRequired.message: Credentials were omitted: enter them before Apply, or explicitly select no authentication.

transferUnsupported_source.message: Source selection is not transferred to this browser. Review the routing source before Apply. Custom source addresses are omitted from exports because they may contain access tokens.

transferUnsupported_language.message: This browser does not import the interface language preference.

transferUnsupported_disabledRules.message: Disabled rules are not stored by this browser and will be omitted.

transferUnsupported_proxyOptions.message: Per-proxy DNS and timeout preferences are not supported here; browser defaults remain in use.

transferUnsupported_torScope.message: This browser cannot use a disabled Tor mode for only .onion or Direct replacement. Review the Tor mode after import.

transferUnsupported_torExclusive.message: This browser supports one Tor mode at a time. Both modes will be disabled until you choose one.

transferUnsupported_warpScope.message: WARP scope switches apply to the whole list here. Mixed switches are conservatively disabled; review them before Apply.

rulesEditorHelp.message: Edit a row, add a rule, or delete it. Save keeps your changes; Apply activates them. Auto removes only that row's override; other matching rules and the automatic source still apply.

rulesAllowlistHelp.message: Auto allowlist entries are shown separately from overrides in this list. When the allowlist is nonempty, unmatched sites use Direct unless an explicit rule takes precedence. The allowlist does not force Auto.

rulesEmpty.message: No site rules. Sites use Auto.

rulesHostError.message: Enter a host without a wildcard; choose Domain and subdomains to include subdomains.

unifiedPopupConflict.message: Settings changed elsewhere. Review the current state and confirm again.

unifiedControlLost.message: The browser or another extension controls the proxy. Check proxy control before applying again.

unifiedUnproven.message: The active settings could not be confirmed. Review the status and select Apply again.

unifiedConflict.message: Settings changed elsewhere. Your edits are preserved. Discard edits to load the latest saved settings and review again.

unifiedSaveFirst.message: Save or discard your edits before applying.

unifiedSavedActive.message: Saved. Previous settings are still active.

unifiedPreparing.message: Previous settings remain active while the new configuration is prepared.

unifiedApplyFailed.message: Changes were not applied. Previous settings remain active.

unifiedSiteSaved.message: Site rule saved, but not applied. Previous settings remain active.

unifiedPopupPending.message: Other saved settings have not been applied. Applying this site rule will also apply those settings.

extensionDescription.message: Routes selected sites through censorship-bypass proxies.

popupLoadFailed.message: The extension state could not be read.

popupHelpOff.message: Enable protection when you are ready.

popupHelpInitializing.message: Requests that need protection remain blocked until recovery finishes.

popupHelpActive.message: Firefox is using the verified local routing configuration.

popupHelpRecovered.message: The routing session was restored after the background page restarted.

popupHelpBlocked.message: Routing is unavailable, so requests that need protection remain blocked. You can disable protection safely.

popupHelpPrivateBlocked.message: Private-window access was removed. Routing is blocked and can be disabled safely.

popupHelpPrivateRequired.message: Allow this extension in private windows before enabling protection.

popupHelpExternal.message: Firefox proxy control changed externally. This extension stopped routing and will not overwrite the other setting.

popupErrorPrivateAccessCheck.message: Firefox did not return the private-window permission state. Protection was not enabled.

popupErrorDataset.message: Verified routing data is unavailable or damaged.

popupErrorSettings.message: Check the saved routing and proxy credential settings.

popupErrorProxyCandidate.message: Configure at least one proxy connection before using Proxy mode.

popupErrorRevision.message: Settings changed elsewhere. The current site state was reloaded; review it and try again.

popupErrorGeneric.message: The operation could not be completed. Check the protection status above.

permissionPrivateAccessExplanation.message: This extension currently controls Firefox's browser-wide proxy settings, which also affect private windows. Access is required so protection is not reported while private windows remain outside the extension's control.

permissionPrivateAccessUnknown.message: Firefox did not return the current permission state. Activation remains unavailable until the extension can verify it.

permissionPrivateAccessSteps.message: Open the Firefox menu → Add-ons and themes → Extensions. Select Runet Censorship Bypass, then under Run in Private Windows choose Allow. Return here when finished.

permissionRestrictedSitesInfo.message: Firefox's Run on sites with restrictions permission is separate and is not required for activation. This extension cannot read that setting; review it manually only when a normal website is restricted. Firefox about: pages cannot be routed.

popupPageCannotBeControlledHelp.message: Firefox does not allow routing rules for this browser or extension page.

popupAutoModeDescription.message: Use the built-in Anticensority routing rules for this site.

popupProxyModeDescription.message: Always use your configured proxy connections for this site.

popupDirectModeDescription.message: Open this site directly, outside Auto.

popupProxyRouteNeedsMethod.message: Proxy mode needs at least one enabled proxy connection.

popupAutomaticSource.message: Anticensority is the verified local routing source.

optionsSubtitle.message: Configure routing and proxy connections for Firefox.

optionsAutomaticSourceHelp.message: Firefox uses verified Anticensority routing data for Auto mode. Routing data define rules, not proxy or service availability.

optionsMaintenanceHelp.message: Check and verify routing data, then prepare an update. Applying verified data can keep protection active and does not apply saved changes.

providerUpdateHelp.message: Check for updates also verifies routing data and prepares any available update. Checking does not change active routing; applying verified data can keep protection active and does not apply saved changes.

providerUpdateActionRequired.message: Resolve the protection status shown above before installing this update.

providerUpdateActiveHelp.message: Verified updates keep current user settings in use; saved changes stay pending. Applying does not turn protection off or enable it if it is off. Remote checks require configured trust and do not prove proxy availability.

providerUpdateError_DATASET_REJECTED.message: The source returned invalid routing data

providerUpdateError_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT.message: The update conflicts with previously verified data

providerUpdateError_STORAGE_FAILED.message: The update could not be prepared or saved

providerUpdateError_TRUST_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: Remote updates are not configured in this build.

optionsAdvancedHelp.message: Configure Direct replacement and local Tor, Tor Browser, or WARP routes.

optionsAboutHelp.message: Runet Censorship Bypass for Firefox uses built-in verified routing data and contains no remote executable code.

optionsLoadFailed.message: The saved settings could not be loaded.

optionsReadOnlyHelp.message: Settings are read-only while Firefox protection is initializing or blocked. Resolve the reported state before editing.

optionsReady.message: Save settings stores your edits. Apply makes saved changes active; unsaved edits are not applied.

optionsSaved.message: Settings saved. Current routing is unchanged until you select Apply.

optionsRevisionConflict.message: Settings changed in another tab. The latest saved settings were loaded; review your changes before saving again.

optionsErrorReadOnly.message: This operation is unavailable in the current protection state. Check the status shown above and try again.

optionsErrorValidation.message: Review the highlighted routing or proxy values. The background validator rejected the configuration.

optionsRulesHelp.message: A host matches only that host. Domain and subdomains includes the named domain itself. Rules are saved in this browser profile, not synchronized with another browser.

flagOwnProxiesOnlyForOwnSites.message: Use configured proxies only for explicit Proxy rules

flagReplaceDirectWithProxy.message: Replace provider Direct with configured proxies

optionsOwnProxiesHelp.message: Candidates are tried in the displayed order before local Tor, Tor Browser, and WARP. HTTP/HTTPS proxy authentication is supported; SOCKS authentication depends on browser and extension support.

optionsPasswordKept.message: The stored password is kept but is never loaded into this page.

optionsPasswordEmpty.message: No stored password is attached to this proxy.

actionTitleExternal.message: Proxy settings are controlled externally. Open the extension for safe recovery.

actionTitleOff.message: Protection is off. Firefox uses its underlying proxy settings.

actionTitleError.message: Firefox protection needs attention. Open the extension for details.

actionTitleHealthWarning.message: The last connection check failed. Open the extension to test again.

actionTitleActiveAuto.message: Protection is active — Current site: Auto

actionTitleActiveProxy.message: Protection is active — Current site: Proxy

actionTitleActiveDirect.message: Protection is active — Current site: Direct

actionTitleActiveUnavailable.message: Protection is active — Current page routing is unavailable

healthConnectionHelp.message: Checks the last explicit Proxy site through the active Firefox routing session. It does not change routing or settings.

healthCode_HEALTH_CHECK_FAILED.message: The connection failed without changing routing. Check the proxy and destination, then try again.

healthCode_HEALTH_CHECK_INTERRUPTED.message: The previous check was interrupted when the event page stopped.

healthCode_HEALTH_CHECK_SUPERSEDED.message: Protection changed while the check was running.

healthCode_HEALTH_NOT_ACTIVE.message: Enable protection before checking the connection.

healthCode_HEALTH_PROXY_CANDIDATE_UNAVAI.message: No enabled proxy candidate is available for this check.

healthCode_HEALTH_PROXY_RULE_REQUIRED.message: Choose explicit Proxy for a site and run the check from its popup first.

healthCode_HEALTH_TARGET_REQUIRED.message: Run the check from the popup of an explicit Proxy site first.

diagnosticsRedactionHelp.message: This report excludes browsing URLs, proxy endpoints, credentials, authentication references, routing-data identifiers, and internal protection state.

notificationsAttentionEnabled.message: Firefox will notify you only when protection control is lost, recovery is blocked, or a requested connection check fails.

notificationControlLoss.message: Another controller changed Firefox proxy settings. Protection stopped safely and was not resumed.

notificationPrivateAccessBlocked.message: Private-window access was removed. Protection is blocked and can be turned off safely.

notificationRecoveryBlocked.message: Firefox could not restore the protected session. Open the extension to review or turn it off.

notificationHealthFailure.message: The requested proxy connection check failed. Open Maintenance to review the sanitized result.
